the biodegradation rate of diesel oil was increased through biostimulation, bioaugmentation and surfactant addition, and the combination of these treatments was more effective than the individual treatments.

the biodegradation and bioremediation potential of hydrocarbon-contaminated soils, with special emphasis in the application of biostimulation and bioaugmentation techniques.

biodegradation is a very complex process, which is influenced by a variety of factors, and the combination of these factors may be more important than any one factor alone.
